rationale: The short thesis required price to stay pinned below the 5m 9-EMA and break down, but the last five 1m candles are a steady grind higher (29.61→29.70), pushing price back to/above the 9-EMA at $29.69 and off the low. With only ~40 minutes to close and the breakdown setup failing to trigger, I exit the tiny -0.17% loss rather than hold a stale short into the close; evidence isn't strong enough to justify flipping long given price remains far below VWAP ($30.38) in the bottom of the range.
